# FarmKeep

> > FarmKeep is an all-in-one farm management platform for tracking livestock health, breeding, production, finances, and operations across farms of all sizes.

FarmKeep provides comprehensive farm management software designed for small farms, homesteads, and agricultural youth programs. The platform integrates livestock record-keeping, breeding management, production tracking, accounting, and task management into a unified system supporting multiple animal types including cattle, goats, poultry, sheep, rabbits, and more.

## Key Topics

- Livestock Management
- Breeding Management
- Production Tracking
- Farm Accounting
- Task Management
- Animal Health Records
- Pedigree Tracking
- Financial Tracking
- 4-H Projects
- FFA Projects
- Cattle Management
- Goat Management
- Poultry Management
- Sheep Management
- Rabbit Management

## Core Features

- [FarmKeep | Modern comprehensive farm management app](https://www.farmkeep.com): FarmKeep homepage: all-in-one farm management for animals, breeding, production, finances, and tasks.
- [FarmKeep Features | All-in-One Farm Management App](https://www.farmkeep.com/features): FarmKeep features overview: livestock, breeding, accounting, production, and task tools.
- [Livestock Record Keeping: Track, Log, Manage](https://www.farmkeep.com/features/livestock-record-keeping): FarmKeep livestock record keeping feature for health, weight, pedigree, and medication tracking.
- [Livestock Breeding Software: Track Breeding & Pedigrees](https://www.farmkeep.com/features/livestock-breeding-software): FarmKeep breeding software for cattle, goats, sheep, poultry gestation and pedigree management.
- [Farm Production & Yield Tracking Software | FarmKeep](https://www.farmkeep.com/features/production-yield-tracking): Track eggs, milk, wool, honey production and yields with FarmKeep to boost profitability.
- [Farm Accounting Software for Small Farms & Ranches | FarmKeep](https://www.farmkeep.com/features/farm-accounting-software): FarmKeep farm accounting: track income, expenses, vendors, customers for small farms.
- [Farm Task Management | Organize, Assign, & Track | FarmKeep](https://www.farmkeep.com/features/farm-task-management): FarmKeep task management: organize, assign, and track farm operations and productivity.
